title: 危险化学品法规与全过程管理

author_source: project/高校实验室安全/037_危险化学品法规与全过程管理/src.py

points.K1: 化学品安全：用、存、废都安全
points.K2: 各类实验室都离不开化学品
points.K3: 守规程：防事故、护样品、保结果
points.S1: 危化品安全法：学校是责任主体
points.S3: 采购要审批，渠道要合规
points.K7: 实时清单，救援心中有数
points.K8: 遗留旧试剂是定时炸弹
points.K9: 定期清查，过期不明当危废
points.S5: 废弃处置交有资质单位

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在化学品柜前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a closed chemical storage cabinet in a lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 第五章化学品安全，先讲法规和全过程管理。
overlay: 危险化学品法规与全过程管理

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现采购、验收、台账、领用、处置五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to five floating icons: a shopping cart, a checklist, a ledger book, a hand taking a bottle, a waste container. No text.
shots.narration: 一瓶试剂从买到废，每一步都要管。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰抱着快递箱走进实验室，拆出一瓶试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a parcel into the lab and unpacks a small reagent bottle from it.
shots.narration: 阿杰自己在网上买了一瓶试剂。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 瓶上没有标签，也没有说明书，阿杰随手放上台面
shots.prompt_en: He puts the bottle, which has no label and no paperwork, casually on the bench. A question mark icon appears.
shots.narration: 没有标签和说明书，也没登记。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师走过来拦住阿杰，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over, stops him and shakes her head kindly but firmly.
shots.narration: 王老师：化学品可不能这样买。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师在白板上画出一条从买到废的链条
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator draws a chain of linked circles on a blank whiteboard, from a cart icon to a waste bin icon. No text.
shots.narration: 我们从头看看，化学品该怎么管。

shots.section_title: 化学品安全：用、存、废都安全
shots.scene: 三个图标：烧杯、试剂柜、废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Three large icons side by side: a beaker, a chemical cabinet, a waste container. No text.
shots.narration: 化学品安全管三件事：用、存、废。
overlay: 化学品安全：用、存、废都安全

shots.section_title: 化学品安全：用、存、废都安全
shots.scene: 小研规范操作，台面整洁，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works carefully at a tidy bench wearing goggles and gloves; a green check appears.
shots.narration: 目的是防止事故，防止伤害。

shots.section_title: 化学品安全：用、存、废都安全
shots.scene: 废液倒进水槽流向河流，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Liquid poured into a sink flows through a pipe into a river, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 也要防止污染环境。

shots.section_title: 化学品安全：用、存、废都安全
shots.scene: 人、环境、地球三个图标被一个盾牌护住
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon protects three small icons: a person, a tree and the earth. No text.
shots.narration: 护人，也护环境。

shots.section_title: 各类实验室都离不开化学品
shots.scene: 微生物实验室里，小研给台面消毒
shots.prompt_en: In a microbiology lab, the female graduate student wipes the bench with disinfectant.
shots.narration: 生物实验室也天天用化学品。
overlay: 各类实验室都离不开化学品

shots.section_title: 各类实验室都离不开化学品
shots.scene: 染色、固定、配试剂三个场景小图
shots.prompt_en: Three small panels: staining a slide, fixing a sample in a jar, mixing a reagent in a flask. No faces, no text.
shots.narration: 消毒、染色、固定、配试剂。

shots.section_title: 各类实验室都离不开化学品
shots.scene: 火焰、腐蚀、骷髅三个危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: Three GHS hazard pictograms: flame, corrosion and skull and crossbones, in red diamond borders. No text.
shots.narration: 不少易燃、有腐蚀性或有毒。

shots.section_title: 各类实验室都离不开化学品
shots.scene: 试剂乱放，旁边人和环境图标亮起警示
shots.prompt_en: Bottles left messy on a bench; warning icons light up over a person icon and a tree icon. No text.
shots.narration: 处理不当，伤人也伤环境。

shots.section_title: 守规程：防事故、护样品、保结果
shots.scene: 小研对照规程卡一步步操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student follows a blank step-by-step procedure card on the bench, ticking each step.
shots.narration: 照规程做，能防溢洒、火灾和爆炸。
overlay: 守规程：防事故、护样品、保结果

shots.section_title: 守规程：防事故、护样品、保结果
shots.scene: 规程卡上跳过一步，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A procedure card with one step skipped by an arrow, crossed out with a red X. No text.
shots.narration: 规程是用事故换来的，别跳步。

shots.section_title: 守规程：防事故、护样品、保结果
shots.scene: 试剂洒在仪器上，仪器表面被腐蚀
shots.prompt_en: A spilled liquid on an instrument panel leaves a corroded patch; a sample tray nearby is ruined. No faces.
shots.narration: 洒了漏了，会腐蚀仪器、毁掉样品。

shots.section_title: 守规程：防事故、护样品、保结果
shots.scene: 两瓶试剂拿混，实验结果图表出现乱线
shots.prompt_en: Two similar bottles are swapped; a result chart on a screen shows scattered wrong points. No text.
shots.narration: 试剂用乱了，结果就不准。

shots.section_title: 依法合规，为的是护人
shots.scene: 一本法律书和一本学校规范并排
shots.prompt_en: A thick law book with a national emblem-like seal and a university rulebook stand side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 国家对危化品有专门的法律法规。

shots.section_title: 依法合规，为的是护人
shots.scene: 王老师带检查组检查实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and two colleagues inspect a lab with blank checklists.
shots.narration: 学校也有安全规范和定期检查。

shots.section_title: 依法合规，为的是护人
shots.scene: 罚单图标变小，人形图标被双手护住
shots.prompt_en: A small penalty ticket icon fades while two hands protect a person icon in the center. No text.
shots.narration: 守规矩不只为免罚，更为护人。

shots.section_title: 危化品安全法：学校是责任主体
shots.scene: 法律书图标旁边，日历翻到五月一日
shots.prompt_en: A law book icon beside a desk calendar flipping to the first day of May. No readable text.
shots.narration: 危化品安全法2026年5月1日起施行。
overlay: 危化品安全法：学校是责任主体

shots.section_title: 危化品安全法：学校是责任主体
shots.scene: 法律书里有一章，画着烧杯图标
shots.prompt_en: An open law book with one chapter marked by a beaker icon. No text.
shots.narration: 专门有一章讲使用安全。

shots.section_title: 危化品安全法：学校是责任主体
shots.scene: 大学和科研院所两栋楼，被责任徽章圈住
shots.prompt_en: A university building and a research institute building, each with a responsibility badge icon. No text.
shots.narration: 学校和科研机构是责任主体。

shots.section_title: 危化品安全法：学校是责任主体
shots.scene: 两本书并列：安全法和条例
shots.prompt_en: Two law books side by side on a shelf, connected by a plus sign. No text.
shots.narration: 危化品安全管理条例要一并遵守。

shots.section_title: 危化品安全法：学校是责任主体
shots.scene: 试剂瓶贴着标签，旁边一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a blank hazard label next to a thin safety data booklet. No text.
shots.narration: 危化品要有中文说明书和标签。

shots.section_title: 危化品安全法：学校是责任主体
shots.scene: 三把锁图标锁住三个特殊柜子
shots.prompt_en: Three special cabinets each locked with a big padlock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆另有严管。

shots.section_title: 全过程管理，三级负责
shots.scene: 流程链：采购、验收、储存、使用、处置五环相扣
shots.prompt_en: Five linked chain rings with icons: cart, checklist, cabinet, beaker, waste bin, forming a closed loop. No text.
shots.narration: 从买到废，全过程闭环管理。

shots.section_title: 全过程管理，三级负责
shots.scene: 三层金字塔：学校、学院、实验室
shots.prompt_en: A three-level pyramid diagram with building icons on each level. No text.
shots.narration: 学校、学院、实验室三级负责。

shots.section_title: 全过程管理，三级负责
shots.scene: 老周站在实验室门口，胸前有负责人徽章
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the lab door wearing a badge, arms folded, looking responsible.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人是第一责任人。

shots.section_title: 全过程管理，三级负责
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰各自抱着自己的试剂瓶点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student each hold their own reagent bottle and nod.
shots.narration: 谁使用，谁负责。

shots.section_title: 采购要审批，渠道要合规
shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑上填申请，老周在旁审批签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank request form on a computer; the older man signs approval beside him.
shots.narration: 买化学品，先提申请，经审批。
overlay: 采购要审批，渠道要合规

shots.section_title: 采购要审批，渠道要合规
shots.scene: 学校采购平台图标连到有资质的供应单位
shots.prompt_en: A university purchasing platform icon connected by an arrow to a certified supplier building with a badge. No text.
shots.narration: 按学校渠道，向有资质的单位购买。

shots.section_title: 采购要审批，渠道要合规
shots.scene: 个人网购、私下转手两个图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a personal online shopping parcel and a hand-to-hand bottle swap, both crossed out with red X marks. No text.
shots.narration: 不私自网购，不私下转让。

shots.section_title: 采购要审批，渠道要合规
shots.scene: 购物车里只放一小瓶，大堆货箱打叉
shots.prompt_en: A shopping cart holds one small bottle; a big pile of boxes beside it is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 按需少量购买，不囤货。

shots.section_title: 采购要审批，渠道要合规
shots.scene: 阿杰把网购的瓶子交给王老师处理
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands the unlabeled bottle to the safety administrator, who puts it in a holding box.
shots.narration: 来路不明的，交老师按规定处理。

shots.section_title: 到货验收：一书一签
shots.scene: 包装箱到货，小研和王老师一起开箱
shots.prompt_en: A delivery box arrives; the female graduate student and the safety administrator open it together, wearing gloves.
shots.narration: 到货先验收，再入库。

shots.section_title: 到货验收：一书一签
shots.scene: 【实拍】手持原包装试剂瓶，核对瓶上中文安全标签（手部特写，本校在用试剂，遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands turning a reagent bottle to check its hazard label with pictograms. No readable text.
shots.narration: 核对标签：品名、规格、危害。

shots.section_title: 到货验收：一书一签
shots.scene: 【实拍】翻看随货的中文安全技术说明书（纸质或电子版，特写，遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands turning the pages of a printed safety data sheet next to a bottle. No readable text.
shots.narration: 安全技术说明书要随货齐全。

shots.section_title: 到货验收：一书一签
shots.scene: 检查瓶盖密封、包装无破损渗漏
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands check that a bottle cap is sealed and the box has no leaks or cracks. No faces.
shots.narration: 包装破损、渗漏的，不收。

shots.section_title: 到货验收：一书一签
shots.scene: 没有标签和说明书的瓶子被推回箱里，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bottle without label or data sheet is pushed back into the box, crossed out with a red X. No text.
shots.narration: 缺签缺书，不收、不用。

shots.section_title: 建台账，账物相符
shots.scene: 小研打开台账本，旁边柜里一排试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank ledger book in front of a cabinet of reagent bottles.
shots.narration: 有多少化学品，要心里有数。

shots.section_title: 建台账，账物相符
shots.scene: 【实拍】扫描试剂瓶上的条码，在学校化学品管理系统登记入库（屏幕遮挡个人信息）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a handheld scanner reading a barcode sticker on a reagent bottle; a blank screen shows a new row added.
shots.narration: 入库扫码登记，一瓶一码。

shots.section_title: 建台账，账物相符
shots.scene: 进、用、废三个箭头都指向台账
shots.prompt_en: Three arrows, incoming bottle, used bottle and waste bottle, all point into a ledger book icon. No text.
shots.narration: 进、用、废，都记在台账上。

shots.section_title: 建台账，账物相符
shots.scene: 定期盘点：账上数字和柜里瓶子一一打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares the ledger with the cabinet, ticking each bottle with green checks.
shots.narration: 定期盘点，账物相符。

shots.section_title: 建台账，账物相符
shots.scene: 账上有一瓶柜里找不到，问号，报告老周
shots.prompt_en: A ledger line has no matching bottle in the cabinet; a question mark appears and she reports to the older man.
shots.narration: 账物不符，查清原因并报告。

shots.section_title: 实时清单，救援心中有数
shots.scene: 实验室门外，消防员拿着化学品清单
shots.prompt_en: Outside a lab door, a firefighter holds a blank chemical list and looks inside carefully.
shots.narration: 出了事，救援人员要知道屋里有啥。
overlay: 实时清单，救援心中有数

shots.section_title: 实时清单，救援心中有数
shots.scene: 清单与柜内试剂同步更新的动画
shots.prompt_en: A list icon updates in sync with bottles being added and removed from a cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 所以清单要实时更新。

shots.section_title: 实时清单，救援心中有数
shots.scene: 一张泛黄的旧清单，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An old yellowed list with outdated entries, crossed out with a red X. No text.
shots.narration: 过时的清单会误导救援。

shots.section_title: 实时清单，救援心中有数
shots.scene: 【实拍】实验室门口安全信息牌特写（本校实验室，遮挡个人电话）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a lab door safety information board with hazard pictograms and a contact area. No readable text.
shots.narration: 门口信息牌写明主要危险和联系人。

shots.section_title: 按需领用，登记去向
shots.scene: 小研领取试剂，在登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a bottle from the cabinet and signs a blank sign-out book.
shots.narration: 领用登记：谁领、领多少、做什么。

shots.section_title: 按需领用，登记去向
shots.scene: 大瓶打叉，小瓶打勾
shots.prompt_en: A huge bottle is crossed out; a small bottle with just the needed amount gets a green check. No text.
shots.narration: 按实验需要少量领取。

shots.section_title: 按需领用，登记去向
shots.scene: 使用前小研阅读标签和说明书，列出风险
shots.prompt_en: Before starting, the female graduate student reads a bottle label and a data booklet and writes a risk note.
shots.narration: 用前看标签和说明书，评估风险。

shots.section_title: 按需领用，登记去向
shots.scene: 试剂瓶被带出实验室门、转给别人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bottle carried out of the lab door and handed to another person, crossed out with a red X. No text.
shots.narration: 不转给他人，不带出实验室。

shots.section_title: 按需领用，登记去向
shots.scene: 用剩的试剂放回原位，台账更新
shots.prompt_en: She returns the remaining bottle to its place in the cabinet and updates the ledger.
shots.narration: 用剩的放回原处，及时登记。

shots.section_title: 遗留旧试剂是定时炸弹
shots.scene: 储藏间角落，几个落满灰尘的旧瓶子
shots.prompt_en: In a dim storage room corner, several dusty old bottles with faded blank labels sit forgotten.
shots.narration: 没人管的旧试剂，是定时炸弹。
overlay: 遗留旧试剂是定时炸弹

shots.section_title: 遗留旧试剂是定时炸弹
shots.scene: 日历一页页翻过，瓶子越来越旧
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages fly by while the old bottles grow dustier. No readable text.
shots.narration: 有一瓶汞，在储藏间被遗忘了多年。

shots.section_title: 遗留旧试剂是定时炸弹
shots.scene: 装修工人搬动架子，旧瓶碰洒出银色小珠
shots.prompt_en: A renovation worker moves a shelf and an old bottle tips over, spilling small silver droplets. No faces.
shots.narration: 装修时被碰洒了。

shots.section_title: 遗留旧试剂是定时炸弹
shots.scene: 工人没戴防护徒手清理，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A worker without gloves or mask cleans up the droplets by hand, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 清理的人没有防护，造成接触。

shots.section_title: 定期清查，过期不明当危废
shots.scene: 王老师带小研清查试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the female graduate student check every shelf of a chemical cabinet together.
shots.narration: 定期清查试剂，不留死角。
overlay: 定期清查，过期不明当危废

shots.section_title: 定期清查，过期不明当危废
shots.scene: 三类瓶子：过期、标签脱落、无人认领
shots.prompt_en: Three bottles marked by icons: an expired calendar, a peeling blank label, and a question mark for no owner. No text.
shots.narration: 过期、不明、没人管的要清出。

shots.section_title: 定期清查，过期不明当危废
shots.scene: 清出的瓶子装进废物箱，贴危废标签
shots.prompt_en: Cleared bottles go into a waste box with a blank hazardous waste label. No faces.
shots.narration: 按危险废物，交学校统一处置。

shots.section_title: 定期清查，过期不明当危废
shots.scene: 毕业生和小研对着台账交接试剂
shots.prompt_en: A graduating student and the female graduate student go through the ledger together and hand over bottles.
shots.narration: 人员离开前，试剂要交接清楚。

shots.section_title: 废弃处置交有资质单位
shots.scene: 废液分类倒入不同的收集桶，贴好标签
shots.prompt_en: Waste liquids are poured into separate labeled collection containers inside a fume hood. No text.
shots.narration: 废弃化学品分类收集，贴好标签。
overlay: 废弃处置交有资质单位

shots.section_title: 废弃处置交有资质单位
shots.scene: 倒进水槽和扔进生活垃圾桶，都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Pouring chemicals into a sink and throwing a bottle into a household trash bin are both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不倒下水道，不混入生活垃圾。

shots.section_title: 废弃处置交有资质单位
shots.scene: 学校收集车运走，送往有资质的处置单位
shots.prompt_en: A university waste collection cart takes sealed containers toward a licensed disposal facility icon. No text.
shots.narration: 学校统一交有资质的单位处置。

shots.section_title: 废弃处置交有资质单位
shots.scene: 台账最后一栏打勾，链条闭合成环
shots.prompt_en: The last column of a ledger gets a check and the chain of rings closes into a loop. No text.
shots.narration: 处置也要登记，台账闭环。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 五环链条依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The five linked rings, cart, checklist, cabinet, beaker, waste bin, light up one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 审批采购，一书一签，验收入账。

shots.section_title: 小结
